rule.description: 当代码中出现非直观的 early-return（尤其是与上游实现行为不一致、或不同代码路径有差异化处理时），必须在 early-return 处添加注释，说明为何需要提前返回以及与上游/其他路径的关系，避免后续维护者无法理解。
checkpoints: 识别 early-return / 短路返回逻辑，判断其意图是否显而易见
若 early-return 是为了适配特定场景（如不同 model runner 版本、PP rank 位置），必须注释说明
注释应点明与上游实现的对应关系（如 "Align with upstream GPUWorker"）
注释应说明为何该路径可以提前返回而其他路径不能

def execute_model(
        self,
        scheduler_output: "SchedulerOutput",
    ) -> Optional[Union[ModelRunnerOutput, AsyncModelRunnerOutput]]:
        # Handle pipeline parallelism: non-last PP ranks only need to
        # receive activations from the previous rank and send to the next.
        if self.pp_rank != self.pp_size - 1:
            # ... (PP recv / forward / send logic) ...
            pp_output = self.pp_handler.receive_and_forward(scheduler_output)
            if self.use_v2_model_runner:
                return None
            # V1 path: must continue to handle PP + KV connector propagation
            return pp_output

        # Last PP rank (or non-PP): run the full model execution path.
        if self.use_v2_model_runner:
            # Model Runner V2 handles its own output construction.
            async_output = await self.model_runner.execute_model(scheduler_output)
            return AsyncModelRunnerOutput(async_output)

        # Model Runner V1 path
        model_runner_output = self.model_runner.execute_model(scheduler_output)
        return model_runner_output

def execute_model(
        self,
        scheduler_output: "SchedulerOutput",
    ) -> Optional[Union[ModelRunnerOutput, AsyncModelRunnerOutput]]:
        # Handle pipeline parallelism: non-last PP ranks only need to
        # receive activations from the previous rank and send to the next.
        if self.pp_rank != self.pp_size - 1:
            # ... (PP recv / forward / send logic) ...
            pp_output = self.pp_handler.receive_and_forward(scheduler_output)

            # Align with upstream GPUWorker: Model Runner V2 has no
            # kv_connector_output to propagate from non-last PP ranks. Model
            # Runner V1 must continue below to handle the PP + KV connector path.
            if self.use_v2_model_runner:
                return None
            # V1 path: must continue to handle PP + KV connector propagation
            return pp_output

        # Last PP rank (or non-PP): run the full model execution path.
        if self.use_v2_model_runner:
            # Model Runner V2 handles its own output construction.
            async_output = await self.model_runner.execute_model(scheduler_output)
            return AsyncModelRunnerOutput(async_output)

        # Model Runner V1 path
        model_runner_output = self.model_runner.execute_model(scheduler_output)
        return model_runner_output
